The current r2 head contains both the Zone Conversion foundation and an early Verse-maintenance integration. The clean foundation merged as PR #159, while the maintenance lifecycle was later corrected and merged as PR #171.

The branch commit chain implements disclosure gating, 2.5D/2D defense-allocation chips, style hierarchy, and profile tests; PR #108 merged that same complete scope from the r2 replay.

The original runtime-definition-port branch was clean-replayed onto the then-current AoT260922 as PR #225 with the same three-file Board/GameEngine injection scope; PR #225 passed Full Inspection and merged.

The original Offering category-multiplicity branch was superseded by the r2 replay merged as PR #223, preserving the agreed 2-per-category default, forced-minimum override, provider override, and final availability fallback.

The original Zone Conversion Card bridge was superseded by the current-base Board runtime definition port in PR #225 plus the clean Card bridge replay in PR #226. Together they preserve Board-owned definitions/mutation and Card-owned quoted payment/preflight semantics.

Draft PR #204/r2 was explicitly superseded after AoT260922 advanced. PR #225 landed the required Board definition injection seam; PR #226 then clean-replayed the complete generic CREATE_ZONE_CONVERSION bridge, dynamic Board quote, stale revalidation, payment safety, targeting, and migration-readiness scope onto that base.
This intermediate Stage1 E2E audit rebase was superseded by the final merged Stage1 E2E audit PR #190, which carries the audit-only registry/runner/test scope on the later target.
The Trial right-panel retirement lineage was rebuilt repeatedly as the target moved; final current-base implementation merged as PR #211 (r4), replacing the original branch.
PR #205/r2 was not merged and was superseded by later clean replays; the final retirement implementation merged as PR #211 (r4).
PR #210/r3 was green but became stale as AoT260922 advanced; its scope was recreated from the later target and merged as PR #211 (r4).
